content.json:
# Tag Governance — รายการที่ยังไม่ผ่าน
ข้อมูลดึงสดจาก Azure Policy (assignment `rg-tag-governance-audit`) ทุกครั้งที่เปิดหน้านี้ · เลือก Subscription ด้านล่าง · ผล Policy อาจช้าราว 1 วันหลังมีการแก้ tag

content.query:
policyresources
| where type == "microsoft.policyinsights/policystates"
| where tolower(tostring(properties.policyAssignmentId)) endswith "/providers/microsoft.authorization/policyassignments/rg-tag-governance-audit"
| where tostring(properties.complianceState) == "NonCompliant"
| extend resource_kind = iff(tostring(properties.resourceType) contains "resourcegroups", "Resource Group", "Virtual Machine")
| extend rid = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceId))
| summarize total = dcount(rid), rg = dcountif(rid, resource_kind == "Resource Group"), vm = dcountif(rid, resource_kind == "Virtual Machine")
| extend p = pack_array(pack("k", "ไม่ผ่านรวม", "n", total), pack("k", "Resource Group", "n", rg), pack("k", "Virtual Machine", "n", vm))
| mv-expand p
| project resource_kind = tostring(p.k), n = toint(p.n)
content.title: จำนวนที่ไม่ผ่าน (นับเป็น resource)

content.query:
policyresources
| where type == "microsoft.policyinsights/policystates"
| where tolower(tostring(properties.policyAssignmentId)) endswith "/providers/microsoft.authorization/policyassignments/rg-tag-governance-audit"
| where tostring(properties.complianceState) == "NonCompliant"
| where tostring(properties.resourceType) =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions/resourcegroups"
| extend resource_id = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceId)), policy = tostring(properties.policyDefinitionReferenceId)
| summarize failed_policies = make_set(policy) by resource_id
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers | where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions/resourcegroups" | project resource_id = tolower(id), rg_name = name, rg_tags = tags) on resource_id
| extend t = todynamic(tostring(rg_tags))
| extend owner_value = tostring(t.owner)
| extend cause = case(isempty(tostring(rg_tags)) or tostring(rg_tags) == "{}", "ไม่มี tag เลย", owner_value =~ "nan", "owner = nan", isempty(owner_value), "ไม่มี owner tag", tostring(failed_policies) contains "owner", "owner รูปแบบผิด", "tag อื่นไม่ครบ")
| extend who = case(cause == "owner รูปแบบผิด" or cause == "tag อื่นไม่ครบ", "Cloud team แก้ได้", "ต้องหา owner / ยืนยัน")
| summarize RG = count() by cause
| order by RG desc
content.title: Resource Group แยกตามสาเหตุ

## รายชื่อ owner ที่ต้องส่งเมล (1 แถวต่อคน)
กดปุ่ม Export to Excel มุมขวาของตาราง เพื่อนำไปส่งเมลจากกล่องทีม · owner ที่คั่นด้วยจุลภาคถูกแยกเป็นรายคน, ค่าว่างและ `nan` ถูกตัดออก (ไปอยู่ในกลุ่ม ต้องหา owner)

content.query:
policyresources
| where type == "microsoft.policyinsights/policystates"
| where tolower(tostring(properties.policyAssignmentId)) endswith "/providers/microsoft.authorization/policyassignments/rg-tag-governance-audit"
| where tostring(properties.complianceState) == "NonCompliant"
| where tostring(properties.resourceType) =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions/resourcegroups"
| extend resource_id = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceId)), policy = tostring(properties.policyDefinitionReferenceId)
| summarize failed_policies = make_set(policy) by resource_id
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers | where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions/resourcegroups" | project resource_id = tolower(id), rg_name = name, rg_tags = tags) on resource_id
| extend t = todynamic(tostring(rg_tags))
| extend owner_value = tostring(t.owner)
| mv-expand owner = split(owner_value, ",")
| extend owner = trim(@"\s+", tostring(owner))
| where owner != "" and owner !~ "nan"
| summarize rg_count = dcount(rg_name), rg_list = array_strcat(make_set(rg_name), ", ") by owner
| extend email_ok = iff(owner matches regex @"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$", "ใช่", "ไม่ใช่ (ตรวจ tag)")
| order by rg_count desc
content.title: owner ของ Resource Group
